hook: Simulations show surrounding solvent steers an iron-oxo radical pair toward one product.
hook_turn: steers an iron-oxo radical pair toward one product.
summary: Trajectory simulations of an Fe-oxo C-H functionalization found that a continuum solvent gives a mix of products, contradicting experiment. Explicit solvent molecules reproduced the observed selectivity by acting as an unequilibrated cage that limits wandering pathways. This is computational only, for one catalyst.
title: Solvent Cage Suppresses Dynamically Induced Entropic Pathways to Provide High Selectivity in Intramolecular Fe-Oxo Radical Rebound Reactions
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
